prompt: write a blink schema for a damage number event the server sends to clients

written.network/main.blink:
-- Output paths are relative to this file; adjust to your project layout.
option ServerOutput = "../src/server/Network/Server.luau"
option ClientOutput = "../src/client/Network/Client.luau"
option TypesOutput = "../src/shared/Network/Types.luau"
option RemoteScope = "DamageNumbers"

enum DamageKind = "Normal" | "Critical" | "Heal" | "Miss" | "Blocked"

struct DamageNumber {
	-- Where to spawn the number (world space). Sent instead of an Instance so
	-- it still works when the target is not streamed in on the client.
	Position: vector,
	Amount: u32,
	Kind: DamageKind,
	-- Optional target for attaching/following; nil when not streamed in.
	Target: Instance(Model)?,
}

-- Cosmetic, high-frequency, loss-tolerant: Unreliable is fine.
-- Payload stays well under the 1000-byte unreliable limit.
event DamageNumberShown {
	From: Server,
	Type: Unreliable,
	Call: ManySync,
	Data: DamageNumber,
}
